bugs.title: Double-ship race condition allows duplicate inventory decrement on concurrent IN_TRANSIT transitions
bugs.summary: transferController checks transfer.status === 'PENDING' without a FOR UPDATE lock on stock_transfers. Concurrent ship requests can both read PENDING, decrement warehouse_inventory twice, and leave physical stock short.

bugs.title: Early validation return in createOrder leaves transaction open in postgres
bugs.summary: orderController calls beginTransaction() before checking required fields. If validation fails, it returns 400 without calling connection.rollback() or connection.release(), causing connection leaks (idle in transaction).

bugs.title: Stock transfer receive path violates NOT NULL constraint on warehouse_inventory.warehouse_id
bugs.summary: When completing a transfer for a product/batch that does not yet exist in the destination branch, transferController inserts into warehouse_inventory without providing warehouse_id, causing PG error 23502.
